paper_title: More Tokens, Lower Precision Towards the Optimal Token-Precision   Trade-off in KV Cache Compression
caption: The results of layer-wise quantized pruning on Llama-3-8B-Instruct, with SnapKV as pruning method. We use 4 KV token 4-bit as baseline and report the relative change. Configurations are modified every 4 layers for the initial and final layers, while intermediate layers are reconfigured every 8 layers.
model_annotation:
This plot illustrates the relative change in performance for different KV cache compression configurations applied layer-wise on Llama-3-8B-Instruct, using a 4× tokens, 4-bit baseline. The x-axis is categorical, representing groups of transformer layers labeled "Layer1-4," "Layer5-12," "Layer13-20," "Layer21-28," and "Layer29-32." The y-axis represents "Relative Change" on a linear scale, ranging from approximately -15% to 5%, with tick marks at 5% intervals (-15%, -10%, -5%, 0%, 5%).

A gray dashed horizontal line represents the baseline of 4× tokens, 4-bit, running flat at 0% across all layer groups. The yellow line with circle markers represents "LB-Avg of 2×tokens, 8-bit," which starts near 0% at Layer1-4, dips slightly to approximately -1% at Layer5-12, returns to roughly 0% at Layer13-20, stays near 0% at Layer21-28, and rises slightly above 0% (approximately +0.5%) at Layer29-32. The red line with square markers represents "LB-Avg of 1×tokens, 16-bit," which begins at approximately -1% at Layer1-4, drops to about -3% at Layer5-12, remains near -2% at Layer13-20 and Layer21-28, and recovers to approximately 0% at Layer29-32. The light blue line with circle markers represents "RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit," which starts near -1% at Layer1-4, decreases to approximately -3% at Layer5-12, drops further to about -6.5% at Layer13-20, recovers to roughly -4% at Layer21-28, and returns to approximately -1% at Layer29-32. The dark blue line with filled square markers represents "RULER4k of 1×tokens, 16-bit," which begins at approximately -1% at Layer1-4, falls to about -5.5% at Layer5-12, reaches its minimum of approximately -14.5% at Layer13-20, recovers to about -10.5% at Layer21-28, and rises to approximately -1% at Layer29-32. All four non-baseline lines exhibit a general pattern of declining values toward the middle layer groups and recovering toward the final layers, with the RULER4k configurations showing more pronounced changes than the LB-Avg configurations.
